hits.hook: You are not your goals.  You are the things you finish.

hits.draft_en:
Hit 32 followers.

Not a huge number. Still the real one.

I'm building CraftDesk for craft-fair and market vendors, launching soon. This week I cleaned up the bio, pinned a plain "why follow" post, and started drafting more replies before 7 AM so I can ship them the same day.

Vendors: if you followed recently, what made you hit follow?
hits.video_tip: Text only. Real follower count 32; progress voice, no invented story.

hits.draft_en:
Weekly invite:

Show me your table setup.

One photo from a recent market, con, or craft fair. Risers, bins, signs, whatever is real.

I'm building CraftDesk for vendors and I learn more from a messy real table than from a perfect mockup.
hits.video_tip: Text only. Weekly invite format; no feature promises.
